title: More ornament

nodes.title: Slide
nodes.body: The pitch moves and arrives. A jump is not a slide. If the contour is messy, nothing is said.

nodes.title: Cran
nodes.body: On low D: a tight figure, cuts and taps, the note still D. Demonstrated before it is asked. Silence is allowed.

nodes.title: Double tap
nodes.body: Two taps on the one note. Too short to hum. If it is unclear, the loop stays quiet.

nodes.title: Triplet
nodes.body: Three notes in the time of one, then you are back. The detector may abstain.

nodes.title: Vibrato
nodes.body: A shimmer on a long note, made with the air, not a finger treated as a grade. You can name it. The app almost never remarks on it.

source: Gestures named for this pack. Each is demonstrated, then asked. The detector may stay silent. Vibrato is named and almost never remarked on.
